## Summary

Wayfarer Fintech Ltd (policy CC-1407): theft of a camera body and lens from an unlocked desk at the insured's office on Harbour Lane. Declined under exclusion 7.1.

## Facts

Wayfarer Fintech Ltd reported the loss on 10 September 2026 under policy CC-1407 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at the insured's office on Harbour Lane [notice of loss]. The loss is described as theft from an unlocked desk of a camera body and lens [notice of loss]. The theft was reported to the police on 12 September 2026, reference CR/2026/4143 [police report]. The items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report]. The items are a camera body (3,307 dollars) and a lens (2,201 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. The file does not state the date on which the theft occurred [notice of loss], [police report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss is theft of business contents at the insured's office, which is the kind of loss clause 4.2 insures [notice of loss], [policy]. The policy schedule is not in the file, so the premises it names are not confirmed.

Exclusion 7.1 applies. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space, unless the equipment was in a locked container or locked room. The items were left in a shared area and were not in a locked container [police report], [policy]. The notice of loss records that the desk was unlocked [notice of loss]. Nothing in the file shows a locked room.

Exclusion 7.5 is not relied on. It applies where theft is alleged and the loss was not reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 12 September 2026, two days after the notice of loss [police report], [notice of loss]. Because the file gives no date of theft, I cannot confirm from the file whether the report was within seven days of the loss [policy]. The decision does not depend on this exclusion.

Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a theft, not gradual deterioration [notice of loss], [policy].

## Decision

Not covered: exclusion 7.1 applies. The claim is declined, and the insured is told why in the terms of the policy.

## Reserve

No reserve is set: the claim is declined.
